question: Consider a sequence of 10 A’s and 8 B’s placed in a row. By a run we mean one or more letters of the same type placed side by side. Here is an arrangement of 10 A’s and 8 B’s which contains 4 runs of A and 4 runs of B: \(AAABBABBBAABAAAABB\). In how many ways can 10 A’s and 8 B’s be arranged in a row so that there are 4 runs of A and 4 runs of B?
